briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: This hour, we saw multiple reports on the death of former FBI Director Robert Mueller, who led the investigation into Russian interference in the 2016 US presidential election. Additionally, we identified a sentencing date for Aimee Bock, the former executive director of Feeding Our Future, who was convicted of wire fraud and conspiracy. The organization was accused of misusing $5.2 million meant for food assistance programs. These developments highlight the ongoing efforts to combat fraud and corruption in Minnesota and at the federal level. We will continue to track these cases and investigate potential connections between entities and programs.
